title: Daytona API key (dtn_): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 5 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: -x glued after the 64-byte body, boundary: _ glued before dtn_, and boundary: _x glued after the 64-byte body, and 2 more. Twin of "Daytona API key (dtn_): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of daytona-api-key-bare-prose: boundary: x glued before dtn_. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
